people.name: Asa
people.line: King of Judah, son of Abijah; father of Jehoshaphat

people.name: Baasha
people.line: Third king of Israel who ruled for 24 years.

people.name: Mizpah
people.line: A city in Benjamin; a place of gathering and judgment

people.name: Ramah
people.line: A town in Benjamin, near Gibeah and Jerusalem

translations.web: Then Asa the king took all Judah, and they carried away the stones of Rama, and its timber, with which Baasha had built; and he built Geba and Mizpah with them.
translations.bsb: Then King Asa brought all the men of Judah, and they carried away the stones of Ramah and the timbers Baasha had used for building. And with these materials he built up Geba and Mizpah.
translations.kjv: Then Asa the king took all Judah; and they carried away the stones of Ramah, and the timber thereof, wherewith Baasha was building; and he built therewith Geba and Mizpah.
translations.asv: Then Asa the king took all Judah; and they carried away the stones of Ramah, and the timber thereof, wherewith Baasha had builded; and he built therewith Geba and Mizpah.
